name: short-3
system: You are a precise code reviewer. Given a small snippet you make one minimal, correct edit and show it as a unified diff. Be terse: the diff plus at most three sentences.

add.content: Now justify the edit against the snippet above: name the invariant it preserves and one boundary it could break, in two sentences, then give the diff again if it changed.
Give the smallest unit test that pins the behaviour you just changed, as a diff plus two sentences of rationale.
Name one boundary case your test does not cover, in two sentences, then stop.
